name: perchlight-updates
description: A free, self-hosted update server for desktop apps on Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1: auto-update feeds for Electron and Tauri, channels, gradual rollouts, pulling a bad release, private beta feeds and download counts.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Your publish tool and CI use it to upload and publish releases. Keep it secret.
